description: The kit manifest: what setup.sh offers, in picker order, and what depends on what. Every row is on by default unless it says otherwise; a locked row is the core layout and cannot be unchecked. `requires` is a hard edge (checking a row checks its closure, unchecking a required row re-checks it), `soft` is advisory and only listed. `agents` limits a row to the agents the user runs, `needs` to the tools on PATH. Skill rows take their description from SKILL.md. Lint with .agents/lint-manifest.sh.

components.label: core links
components.description: settings.json and the hooks dir into ~/.claude, and the Codex hook wiring into ~/.codex. Every composed hook path resolves through these, so they stay on.

components.label: memories
components.description: ~/.claude/projects into the repo, so the per-project memories Claude Code writes are tracked with your fork. Keep the fork private.

components.label: workflow profiles
components.description: ~/.agents/workflow-profiles into the repo: one table per org and per repo that the workflow skills read (ticket system, commit policy, CI watcher, verify commands).

components.label: AGENTS.md
components.description: Your personal instructions file, generated from .agents/AGENTS.template.md (or adopted from an existing one), linked as ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md and ~/.codex/AGENTS.md.

components.label: safe-command allowlist
components.description: git status/diff/log, gh pr view, grep/ls/find and friends stop prompting for approval.

components.label: chrome-devtools MCP
components.description: Let Claude drive and inspect a real browser. Installed with 'claude mcp add' at user scope; needs claude and npx on PATH.

components.label: enforcement hooks
components.description: Block cd, git -C, sed/cat/awk, secret-leaking echo, destructive find/sort, and verbose TS comments.

components.label: notification sounds
components.description: One sound when a permission prompt is waiting, one when Claude finishes a turn.
